watch.summary: The creator reacts in horror to a creepy matte-black goat robot promo, imagining it breaking into his home with a saw.

beats.what: Creator calls the goat-headed robot demonic.
Creator questions who thought making an all-black matte robot was a good idea.
Footage shows the robot standing outside a door holding tools and a saw.
Creator describes the robot shaking your door handle while staring into your eyes.
Creator jokes that he would rather end his own life than let the robot drag him away.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I'll be doing the job myself.
watch.why: The creator's vivid scenario description turns a creepy robotics showcase into an absurdly relatable nightmare. His dramatic punchline about giving up immediately if cornered provides a funny button to the clip.
